name: Commerce Shipping same as billing
description: Adds a 'shipping information is the same as billing' checkbox to Drupal Commerce checkout, copying the order's billing address onto the shipping profile (billing to shipping). Flips Commerce Shipping's built-in shipping-to-billing behaviour and disables it. One service (subclass of commerce_shipping.profile_field_copy) plus checkout-pane overrides; no routes, permissions, or config UI. Version 1.0.0-alpha3 (pre-stable).
project_description:
See [#3163551] for the original issue. 
 The Commerce Shipping Same as Billing module for Drupal simplifies the checkout process by allowing customers to use their billing address as their shipping address with a single click. This feature is especially useful for e-commerce sites where customers frequently have the same billing and shipping addresses.

 By default, the commerce_shipping module provides the functionality to set the billing address to be the same as the shipping address. This module reverses this functionality, allowing the shipping address to be the same as the billing address.

 Dependency 
 Requires the commerce_shipping module for full functionality.
